value.summary: The change adds a small text-formatting utility module with no security-relevant surface: no untrusted input reaches a dangerous sink, no subprocess or network calls, no deserialization, no path handling, no secrets, and no dependency or CI changes. The string slicing in `shorten` and `first_sentence` is byte-indexed but only ever cuts on ASCII boundary characters (`' '`, `'. '`), so it is char-boundary safe by construction.
